events.title: Diageo's Indian unit's profit jumps on premium demand
events.body: May 14 (Reuters) - India's United Spirits, which distributes Johnnie Walker and Antiquity whiskeys, posted about a 27% rise in fourth quarter profit on Friday, boosted by demand for its premium brands
